rules.roads: Natural Earth European-route/motorway lines form class 0; major highways and expressways at scale rank 7 or better form class 1. Geometry is schematic map art, not a complete road inventory.
rules.rail: Natural Earth rail scale ranks 1–5 form main lines and ranks 6–8 secondary lines. Geometry is schematic and incomplete.
rules.ports: Eurostat ports with at least one million metric tonnes handled in 2023, positioned by Natural Earth or their namesake commune.
rules.airports: Metropolitan airports with at least 100,000 passengers on board in 2023. Hub letters are local display-size buckets.
